data.title: ON HER BIRTHDAY, BEYONCÉ MAKES A $2 MILLION GIFT TO THE STUDIO MUSEUM IN HARLEM
data.description: A significant cultural institution in New York City, with a legacy of almost six decades, has been dedicated to promoting the art of African descent. In a noteworthy gesture to commemorate her birthday, Beyoncé, a renowned global entertainer, entrepreneur, and art enthusiast, has contributed a generous donation of $2 million to the institution. The donation is a testament to her support for the institution's mission and the artists it champions.

data.title: Your Ecommerce Accountant : MTD Rollout Expands to 2.9 Million Sole Traders and Landlords by 2028
data.description: Data from HMRC reveals that 864,000 individuals are included in the initial income bracket exceeding £50,000 under Making Tax Digital. By 2027 and 2028, over two million more sole traders and landlords are anticipated to join as the threshold decreases. The implementation of Making Tax Digital for Income Tax is expected to have a significant impact on tax reporting procedures in the upcoming years.

data.title: Armor Health and the Stark County Sheriff's Office Partner in Launching PATH Program at Stark County Jail and Celebrate First Graduates
data.description: In September 4, 2026, Armor Health, a leading national provider of correctional healthcare services, introduced the Prevention, Accountability, Treatment & Healing (PATH) Program at Stark County Jail in Canton, Ohio. This initiative, which commenced in July, is designed to provide comprehensive support and services to inmates at the facility. More information can be found on Armor Health's website at ArmorHealthcare.com.
